doc: Finite Boolean graph fact only: every partially occupied ring has an occupied-to-vacant contact. No real-rate decision procedure is involved.

name: CGB.SeedMemory.partial_hold_bound
signature:
∀ (x : Fin 4 → Bool),
  0 < CGB.Models.seed.total x →
    CGB.Models.seed.total x < 4 →
      ∀ (sched : ℕ → Fin 4 → Bool) (n : ℕ),
        ∏ t ∈ Finset.range n, CGB.Models.seed.kernel CGB.SeedMemory.world.clock (sched t) x x ≤ (1 - 1 / 18) ^ n
doc: The probability of never leaving a partial microstate has a geometric bound, while the coarse memory remains. This is not a bound on return visits.

name: CGB.SeedMemory.partial_rate_one
signature:
∀ (x : Fin 4 → Bool),
  0 < CGB.Models.seed.total x →
    CGB.Models.seed.total x < 4 →
      ∀ (s : Fin 4 → Bool), ∃ a, CGB.Models.seed.act a s x ≠ x ∧ CGB.Models.seed.rate a s x = 1
doc: Every partial microstate has a state-changing rate-one hop under every stimulus, including quiet. The rates and seed state space are unchanged.

name: CGB.SeedMemory.physical_memory_component
signature:
CGB.Models.seed.Axioms ∧
  CGB.Models.seed.Clocked CGB.SeedMemory.world.clock ∧
    CGB.Models.seed.Remembers CGB.SeedMemory.world ∧
      ∃ a x,
        0 < CGB.Models.seed.rate a CGB.SeedMemory.world.quiet x ∧ CGB.Models.seed.act a CGB.SeedMemory.world.quiet x ≠ x
doc: One unchanged admitted physical medium jointly has actual memory and nontrivial quiet events in this world. No `Lives` conclusion is asserted.

name: CGB.SeedMemory.prefix_pos
signature:
∀ (b : Bool),
  0 <
    CGB.Models.seed.law CGB.SeedMemory.world (fun x => CGB.SeedMemory.world.sense) 1 CGB.SeedMemory.beforeWrite (some b)
doc: Both input tags have positive probability at the very same reachable body.

name: CGB.SeedMemory.quiet_has_nontrivial_event
signature: ∃ a x, 0 < CGB.Models.seed.rate a CGB.SeedMemory.world.quiet x ∧ CGB.Models.seed.act a CGB.SeedMemory.world.quiet x ≠ x
doc: Quiet is not an identity dynamics: a positive-rate event changes the body.

name: CGB.SeedMemory.quiet_preserves
signature:
∀ (x y : Fin 4 → Bool),
  0 < CGB.Models.seed.kernel CGB.SeedMemory.world.clock CGB.SeedMemory.world.quiet x y →
    CGB.SeedMemory.observe y = CGB.SeedMemory.observe x
doc: Positive quiet transitions preserve the readout even though hops continue.

name: CGB.SeedMemory.remembers
signature: CGB.Models.seed.Remembers CGB.SeedMemory.world
doc: The original full-body CMI memory clause, derived from actual positive prefixes and source intake, with no assumed positive-information premise.

name: CGB.SeedMemory.write_act
signature: CGB.Models.seed.act (Sum.inr true) CGB.Models.food CGB.SeedMemory.beforeWrite = CGB.SeedMemory.afterWrite

name: CGB.SeedMemory.write_pos
signature:
0 <
  CGB.Models.seed.kernel CGB.SeedMemory.world.clock (CGB.SeedMemory.world.sense (some true)) CGB.SeedMemory.beforeWrite
    CGB.SeedMemory.afterWrite

name: CGB.SeedMemory.write_totals
signature: CGB.Models.seed.total CGB.SeedMemory.beforeWrite = 1 ∧ CGB.Models.seed.total CGB.SeedMemory.afterWrite = 2
doc: Food really increases total from one to two through the existing source.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.action_consequence_model_exists
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} (c : CGB.SelfProduction.Contract S A I),
  ∃ predict, ∀ (s : S) (a : A), predict s a = c.step s (c.response s a)
doc: The action-conditioned boundary rule itself is an exact self-consequence model when that rule is available to the organism's persistent state.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.action_distinction_preserved
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} (c : CGB.SelfProduction.Contract S A I) {s : S},
  c.viable s →
    ∀ {a a' : A},
      c.step s (c.response s a) ≠ c.step s (c.response s a') →
        ∃ predict, predict s a ≠ predict s a' ∧ ∀ (t : S) (b : A), predict t b = c.step t (c.response t b)
doc: If two actions have different boundary consequences at a viable state, the exact self-consequence model preserves that distinction.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.actual_actions_reproduce_trajectory
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} (c : CGB.SelfProduction.Contract S A I) (n : ℕ),
  CGB.SelfProduction.controlledTrajectory c (fun t => c.action (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory c t)) n =
    CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory c n
doc: Replaying the actual actions in the same world reproduces the generated trajectory.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.association_affine_language_nll_bound
doc: The associative interference certificate propagates through an affine language head into a per-byte NLL bound. The reference logits use the value associated with the same probe. No future distribution or training result is assumed. An old-state residual, if present, must be included separately.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.association_assimilation_improves_iff
doc: On a fixed query and target, the existing assimilation improves squared prediction error exactly when its query change points sufficiently towards the target without overshooting. The target is an externally specified future value, not assumed to be known during the update.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.association_assimilation_query_change
signature:
∀ {dv dk : ℕ} (state weighted : Fin dv → Fin dk → ℝ) (precision weight query : Fin dk → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin dk), 0 < precision j) →
    (∀ (j : Fin dk), 0 ≤ weight j) →
      ∀ (o : Fin dv),
        CGB.Generation.associationRead (fun i j => (precision j * state i j + weighted i j) / (precision j + weight j))
              query o -
            CGB.Generation.associationRead state query o =
          ∑ j, query j * ((weighted o j - weight j * state o j) / (precision j + weight j))
doc: Query change under the existing natural-parameter assimilation: `weight` is the per-slot sum of observation weights and `weighted` the corresponding value-weighted sum. The identity includes zero observation weight and allows slot contributions to cancel; no separate resource state is introduced.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.association_assimilation_softmax_improves_iff
signature:
∀ {dv dk nb : ℕ} (state weighted : Fin dv → Fin dk → ℝ) (precision weight query query' : Fin dk → ℝ)
  (head head' : Fin nb → Fin dv → ℝ) (bias bias' : Fin nb → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : Fin dk), 0 < precision j) →
    (∀ (j : Fin dk), 0 ≤ weight j) →
      ∀ (target : Fin nb),
        have old := fun b => bias b + ∑ i, head b i * CGB.Generation.associationRead state query i;
        have updated := fun b =>
          bias' b +
            ∑ i,
              head' b i *
                CGB.Generation.associationRead
                  (fun i j => (precision j * state i j + weighted i j) / (precision j + weight j)) query' i;
        have delta := fun b =>
          bias' b - bias b +
            ∑ i,
              ((head' b i - head b i) * CGB.Generation.associationRead state query i +
                head' b i *
                  (∑ j, state i j * (query' j - query j) +
                    ∑ j, query' j * ((weighted i j - weight j * state i j) / (precision j + weight j))));
        CGB.Medium.softmax old target < CGB.Medium.softmax updated target ↔
          (∑ i, Real.exp (old i) * Real.exp (delta i)) / ∑ i, Real.exp (old i) < Real.exp (delta target)
doc: Under slotwise assimilation and an arbitrary affine-head update, a target's softmax probability rises exactly when its multiplicative change exceeds the old distribution's average. The change includes head, query and state changes; no learned head or update rule is assumed.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.association_delta_read_contract
signature:
∀ {dv dk : ℕ} (state : Fin dv → Fin dk → ℝ) (key query : Fin dk → ℝ) (value : Fin dv → ℝ) (β : ℝ),
  CGB.Generation.dot key key = 1 →
    (∀ (o : Fin dv),
        CGB.Generation.associationRead (fun i => CGB.Generation.tiedWrite key β (value i) (state i)) key o - value o =
          (1 - β) * (CGB.Generation.associationRead state key o - value o)) ∧
      ∀ (o : Fin dv),
        CGB.Generation.associationRead (fun i => CGB.Generation.tiedWrite key β (value i) (state i)) query o -
            CGB.Generation.associationRead state query o =
          β * (value o - CGB.Generation.associationRead state key o) * CGB.Generation.dot query key
doc: Assemble the existing row delta and associative readout contracts on the same value-by-key matrix. Unit-key write error contracts by `1 - β`; any query changes by its overlap with the written key times the innovation. This is the mean-state reference update, not the Bayesian assimilation path.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.candidate_erase_balance
signature:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {O : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H]
  (possible : CGB.CausalLearning.Support H C A O) {B : ℕ} (m : CGB.CausalLearning.Memory H B) (c : C) (a : A) (o : O),
  (CGB.CausalLearning.advance possible m c a o).candidates.card +
      CGB.SelfProduction.candidate_erase_count possible m c a o =
    m.candidates.card

name: CGB.SelfProduction.candidate_erase_ge_fee
signature:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {O : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H]
  (possible : CGB.CausalLearning.Support H C A O) {B : ℕ} (m : CGB.CausalLearning.Memory H B) (c : C) (a : A) (o : O),
  CGB.CausalLearning.fee possible m c a o ≤ CGB.SelfProduction.candidate_erase_count possible m c a o

name: CGB.SelfProduction.candidate_erasure_not_unbounded_signal
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {Model : Type u_2} {Ctx : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Obs : Type u_5} {Byte : Type u_6}
  {Answer : Type u_7} [inst : Fintype Model] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Model] [inst_2 : Fintype Byte]
  [inst_3 : Nonempty Byte] (L : CGB.SelfProduction.LanguageSelfProductionCandidate Hist Model Ctx Act Obs Byte Answer)
  (h : ℕ → Hist) (b : ℕ → Byte),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), h (n + 1) = L.base.advanceHistory (h n) (b n)) →
    ¬CGB.ActiveInference.unbounded fun n => CGB.SelfProduction.language_dissipation L (L.base.encode (h n)) (b n)
doc: Finite one-way candidate elimination cannot itself supply the unbounded signal assumed by the active-inference contract.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.candidate_reference_probe_loss_eq_dissipation
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {Model : Type u_2} {Ctx : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Obs : Type u_5} {Byte : Type u_6}
  {Answer : Type u_7} [inst : Fintype Model] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Model] [inst_2 : Fintype Byte]
  [inst_3 : Nonempty Byte] (L : CGB.SelfProduction.LanguageSelfProductionCandidate Hist Model Ctx Act Obs Byte Answer)
  (h : Hist) (b : Byte),
  CGB.SelfProduction.probeLoss (CGB.SelfProduction.candidateReferenceProbeBridge L).probe
      (CGB.SelfProduction.candidateReferenceProbeBridge L).recoverable (L.base.encode h)
      (L.base.next (L.base.encode h) b) (L.base.encode h).candidates (L.base.next (L.base.encode h) b).candidates =
    CGB.SelfProduction.language_dissipation L (L.base.encode h) b

name: CGB.SelfProduction.categorical_precision_next_loss_direction
signature:
∀ {Byte : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq Byte] (c : Byte → ℝ) (observed next : Byte) (p w : ℝ),
  0 < p →
    0 < w →
      0 < c next →
        c next < 1 →
          have q := c next + w / (p + w) * ((if next = observed then 1 else 0) - c next);
          0 < q ∧
            (-Real.log q < -Real.log (c next) ↔ next = observed) ∧ (-Real.log (c next) < -Real.log q ↔ next ≠ observed)
doc: Categorical precision-weighted assimilation improves the next symbol's log loss exactly when that symbol repeats the observed symbol; a different symbol becomes strictly less likely. This is a one-step realised outcome, not a claim about expected loss for a general language distribution.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.counterfactual_passive_bound_forces_activity
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} (c : CGB.SelfProduction.Contract S A I) (passive : A)
  (intake : S → I → ℕ),
  (∀ (actions : ℕ → A),
      CGB.ActiveInference.eventuallyPassive actions passive →
        ∃ B,
          ∀ (T : ℕ),
            CGB.ActiveInference.cumulative
                (fun n =>
                  have s := CGB.SelfProduction.controlledTrajectory c actions n;
                  intake s (c.response s (actions n)))
                T ≤
              B) →
    (CGB.ActiveInference.unbounded fun n =>
        have s := CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory c n;
        intake s (c.response s (c.action s))) →
      ¬CGB.ActiveInference.eventuallyPassive (fun n => c.action (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory c n)) passive
doc: If every eventually passive intervention in the same world has bounded intake, an actual trajectory with unbounded intake cannot become permanently passive. The universal premise also covers the always-passive intervention.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.delayed_readout_capacity_with_retrieval
signature:
∀ {History : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {View : Type u_3} {Answer : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype History]
  [inst_1 : Fintype State] [inst_2 : Fintype View] (internal : History → State) (returned : History → View)
  (required : History → Answer) (read : State → View → Answer),
  Function.Injective required →
    (∀ (h : History), read (internal h) (returned h) = required h) →
      Fintype.card History ≤ Fintype.card State * Fintype.card View
doc: For a fixed future query, externally retrieved views share the burden of distinguishing histories with the finite body. If every listed history needs a different answer, the number of histories cannot exceed the product of body states and possible returned views. No assumption stores the external world inside the body; retrieval itself must actually supply the view.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.effective_write_erases_distinction
signature:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {C : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {O : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq H]
  (possible : CGB.CausalLearning.Support H C A O) {B : ℕ} (m : CGB.CausalLearning.Memory H B) (c : C) (a : A) (o : O),
  CGB.CausalLearning.fee possible m c a o = 1 → 0 < CGB.SelfProduction.candidate_erase_count possible m c a o

name: CGB.SelfProduction.existing_renewable_autonomous_cycle
signature:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
        (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier) (3 * k) =
      CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search ∧
    CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
          (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier) (3 * k + 1) =
        CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aSpent ∧
      CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
          (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier) (3 * k + 2) =
        CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady
doc: In the specified deterministic witness world the same finite carrier repeats the writing, refill and reopening cycle at every natural time scale. This is a mathematical interface witness, not a language capability claim.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.existing_renewable_carrier_reuses_old_rule
signature:
CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search
      CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.answerA =
    CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aSpent ∧
  CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aSpent
        CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.feed =
      CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady ∧
    CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
        CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.miss =
      CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search
doc: The derived transition admits the old witness's writing, renewal and reopening steps on one finite carrier.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.existing_renewable_cycle_active_and_viable
signature:
(∀ (n : ℕ),
    CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
        (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier) n ≠
      CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum) ∧
  ¬CGB.ActiveInference.eventuallyPassive
        (fun n =>
          CGB.RenewableLearning.policy
            (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
              (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier) n))
        0 ∧
    CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableResponse CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search 2 ≠
      CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableResponse CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search 0
doc: The finite witness remains outside vacuum, does not become permanently passive, and has an action-sensitive boundary in the declared witness world.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.existing_renewable_open_stream_witness
signature:
∀ (bits : ℕ → Bool),
  ∃ x,
    x 0 = (CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search, 0) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ),
          x (n + 1) =
            (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
                  (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits)).step
              (x n)
              ((CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
                    (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits)).response
                (x n)
                ((CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
                      (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits)).action
                  (x n)))) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ), (x n).1 ≠ CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), (x n).2 = n
doc: The external cursor advances each tick while the same finite organism stays in its stated non-vacuum region, for any external bit sequence.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.exists_conditionally_operating_language_life_of_minimal_generator
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {Model : Type u_2} {Ctx : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Obs : Type u_5} {Byte : Type u_6}
  {Answer : Type u_7} [inst : Fintype Model] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Model] [inst_2 : Fintype Byte]
  [inst_3 : Nonempty Byte]
  (G : CGB.SelfProduction.MinimalLanguageSelfProductionGenerator Hist Model Ctx Act Obs Byte Answer),
  (CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.encode
        ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.trajectory 0) =
      (CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.encode
        (CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).seed →
    (∀ (n : ℕ),
        (CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.encode
            ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.trajectory (n + 1)) =
          (CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.next
            ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.encode
              ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.trajectory n))
            ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).world_response
              ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.encode
                ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.trajectory n))
              ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.policy
                ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.encode
                  ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.trajectory n))))) →
      ∀ (m : ℝ),
        (∀ (h : Hist),
            CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy
                ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.stream h)
                ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.allocation
                  ((CGB.SelfProduction.materializeLanguageSelfProductionGenerator G).base.encode h)) <
              Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Byte) - m) →
          ∀ p ≤ 1,
            ∀ (q : ℕ → ℝ),
              q 0 ≤ 1 →
                (∀ (n : ℕ), q (n + 1) ≤ (1 - p) * q n) →
                  ∃ L,
                    CGB.SelfProduction.language_infinite_stream_life_spec L ∧
                      CGB.LanguageLifeAdmission.joint_admission_spec L.base ∧
                        (∀ (n : ℕ),
                            CGB.SelfProduction.language_viable L
                              (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.language_contract L) n)) ∧
                          ¬CGB.ActiveInference.eventuallyPassive
                                (fun n =>
                                  L.base.policy
                                    (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.language_contract L) n))
                                L.base.passive ∧
                            (∀ (h : Hist),
                                0 <
                                  CGB.PredictiveHarvest.growth (L.base.stream h) (L.base.allocation (L.base.encode h)) -
                                    m) ∧
                              ∀ (n : ℕ), q n ≤ (1 - p) ^ n
doc: Existential form of the total gate. Once a minimal generator and its world conditions are supplied, materialization produces one concrete language candidate satisfying the current life specification, active self-production, predictive payment, and block-learning bound together.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.exists_infinite_self_producing_trajectory
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} (c : CGB.SelfProduction.Contract S A I),
  ∃ x,
    x 0 = c.initial ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ), x (n + 1) = c.step (x n) (c.response (x n) (c.action (x n)))) ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), c.viable (x n)
doc: **Unbounded self-production.** The contract generates one trajectory indexed by all natural causal ticks, and every prefix remains in its viable niche. This is the deterministic infinite-duration statement.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.exists_language_infinite_stream_life_of_minimal_generator
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {Model : Type u_2} {Ctx : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Obs : Type u_5} {Byte : Type u_6}
  {Answer : Type u_7} [inst : Fintype Model] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Model] [inst_2 : Fintype Byte]
  [inst_3 : Nonempty Byte]
  (G : CGB.SelfProduction.MinimalLanguageSelfProductionGenerator Hist Model Ctx Act Obs Byte Answer),
  ∃ L, CGB.SelfProduction.language_infinite_stream_life_spec L
doc: Given an admissible minimal generator, there is a candidate satisfying the candidate specification. This assumes the generator and does not establish existence of an organism satisfying all original life requirements.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.exists_renewable_language_life_of_generator
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5} [inst : Fintype Byte]
  [inst_1 : Nonempty Byte] (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageLifeGenerator Hist State Byte Act Answer) (m : ℝ),
  (∀ (s : State),
      CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy (G.stream s) (G.allocation s) < Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Byte) - m) →
    ∃ x,
      x 0 = G.carrier.encode G.carrier.seed ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ),
            x (n + 1) =
              CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext G.carrier (x n)
                (G.carrier.world_response (x n) (G.carrier.policy (x n)))) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ), (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G.carrier).viable (x n)) ∧
            ¬CGB.ActiveInference.eventuallyPassive (fun n => G.carrier.policy (x n)) G.passive ∧
              (¬∀ (a : Act) (b : Byte), G.predict b = G.response a b) ∧
                (∀ (s : State), 0 < CGB.PredictiveHarvest.growth (G.stream s) (G.allocation s) - m) ∧
                  (∀ (N : ℕ),
                      ∃ n,
                        N ≤ n ∧
                          CGB.SelfProduction.renewablePredictiveUpdateEvent G.carrier G.stream G.allocation (x n)
                            (G.carrier.world_response (x n) (G.carrier.policy (x n)))) ∧
                    ¬∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → x (n + 1) = x n
doc: Existential form of the renewable gate. The generated trajectory is the same one used by the carrier, active signal, and recurrent-learning clauses; it is not a separately chosen witness.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.generated_boundary_signal_forces_active
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {Model : Type u_2} {Ctx : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Obs : Type u_5} {Byte : Type u_6}
  {Answer : Type u_7} [inst : Fintype Model] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Model] [inst_2 : Fintype Byte]
  [inst_3 : Nonempty Byte] (L : CGB.SelfProduction.LanguageSelfProductionCandidate Hist Model Ctx Act Obs Byte Answer)
  (intake : CGB.CausalLearning.Memory Model L.base.reserve → Byte → ℕ),
  (CGB.ActiveInference.unbounded fun n =>
      have s := CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.language_contract L) n;
      intake s (L.world_response s (L.base.policy s))) →
    CGB.ActiveInference.passiveBounded
        (fun n => L.base.policy (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.language_contract L) n))
        (fun n =>
          have s := CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.language_contract L) n;
          intake s (L.world_response s (L.base.policy s)))
        L.base.passive →
      (∀ (n : ℕ),
          CGB.SelfProduction.language_viable L
            (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.language_contract L) n)) ∧
        ¬CGB.ActiveInference.eventuallyPassive
            (fun n => L.base.policy (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.language_contract L) n))
            L.base.passive
doc: On the generated trajectory, a boundary-derived nonnegative integer signal supports the existing active conclusion when the explicit unbounded intake and passive-depletion conditions hold. No extra stored state is used.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.generated_history_encodes_self_production
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {Model : Type u_2} {Ctx : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Obs : Type u_5} {Byte : Type u_6}
  {Answer : Type u_7} [inst : Fintype Model] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Model] [inst_2 : Fintype Byte]
  [inst_3 : Nonempty Byte] (L : CGB.SelfProduction.LanguageSelfProductionCandidate Hist Model Ctx Act Obs Byte Answer)
  (n : ℕ),
  L.base.encode (CGB.SelfProduction.language_generated_history L n) =
    CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.language_contract L) n
doc: The generated history and the existing state recursion agree without a separately postulated trajectory-alignment premise.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.grace_action_intervention_contrast
signature:
(∀ (t : ℕ) (z : CGB.RenewableLearning.S) (e : Option Unit) (z' : CGB.RenewableLearning.S),
    CGB.SelfProduction.graceActionMachine.step (CGB.RenewableLearning.policy (z.1 ())) z e z' =
      (CGB.GraceRecovery.process false CGB.GraceRecovery.natural).step t z e z') ∧
  CGB.SelfProduction.graceActionMachine.step 0 CGB.RenewableLearning.initial (some ())
        (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.missA) =
      1 ∧
    CGB.SelfProduction.graceActionMachine.step 0
          (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.missA) (some ())
          (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.probeA) =
        1 ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        CGB.Exchange.survival CGB.GraceRecovery.body CGB.GraceRecovery.world CGB.GraceRecovery.ec
            CGB.GraceRecovery.material false CGB.GraceRecovery.natural n =
          1
doc: Reconnecting the body's policy reproduces every transition of the registered grace process; overriding action zero from birth reaches vacuum in two certain steps. Normal operational survival stays one at every tick.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.grace_action_world_matches
signature:
∀ (w v : CGB.RenewableLearning.Env) (q : CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell),
  q ≠ CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum →
    CGB.GraceRecovery.moves w (fun x => q) v = CGB.SelfProduction.graceActionWorld w (CGB.RenewableLearning.policy q) v

name: CGB.SelfProduction.grace_action_zero_vacuum_probability
signature:
CGB.Energetics.law (CGB.SelfProduction.graceActionAlways 0) CGB.RenewableLearning.initial 2
    (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.probeA) =
  1

name: CGB.SelfProduction.grace_exists_recurrently_intaking_path
signature:
∃ path event,
  path 0 = CGB.RenewableLearning.initial ∧
    (∀ (t : ℕ),
        0 < (CGB.GraceRecovery.process false CGB.GraceRecovery.natural).step t (path t) (event t) (path (t + 1))) ∧
      ∀ (start : ℕ),
        ∃ t,
          start ≤ t ∧
            t < start + 3 ∧
              CGB.Exchange.intake CGB.GraceRecovery.body CGB.GraceRecovery.world CGB.GraceRecovery.material
                  CGB.GraceRecovery.natural t (path t) (event t) (path (t + 1)) =
                true
doc: The original process has at least one infinite supported path, and each three-tick window on that path contains actual intake.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.grace_historical_memory_iff_one_write
signature:
CGB.GraceRecovery.body.Remembers CGB.GraceRecovery.world ↔
  ∃ n₀,
    0 <

name: CGB.SelfProduction.masked_open_world_information_limit
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5} {World : Type u_6}
  (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageGenerator Hist State Byte Act Answer)
  (W : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableOpenWorld G World) (quiet : Byte) (s : State) (w₀ w₁ : World)
  (target : State × World → Bool) (predict : State → ℝ) (n : ℕ),
  target (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)) = false →
    target (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁)) = true →
      0 < predict (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)).1 →
        predict (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)).1 < 1 →
          (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)).1 =
              (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁)).1 ∧
            G.policy (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)).1 =
                G.policy (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁)).1 ∧
              target (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)) = false ∧
                target (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁)) = true ∧
                  -(Real.log (1 - predict (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)).1) +
                          Real.log (predict (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁)).1)) /
                      2 ≥
                    Real.log 2
doc: Under the same fixed delivered symbol, identical starting bodies have identical body states and actions for any two evolving external worlds. If those worlds instead require opposite equally likely next-bit predictions, the common body-only prediction has at least one bit of average log loss. The separation of future targets is an explicit world condition.

signature:

  (target : State × World → Bool) (predict : State → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (viable : State × World → Prop) (a₀ a₁ : Act),
  a₀ ≠ a₁ →
    target (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)) = false →
      target (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁)) = true →
        0 < predict (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)).1 →
          predict (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)).1 < 1 →
            viable (CGB.SelfProduction.openActionStep G W (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)) a₀) →
              viable (CGB.SelfProduction.openActionStep G W (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁)) a₁) →
                (∀ (a : Act),
                    viable
                        (CGB.SelfProduction.openActionStep G W (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀))
                          a) →
                      a = a₀) →
                  (∀ (a : Act),
                      viable
                          (CGB.SelfProduction.openActionStep G W (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁))
                            a) →
                        a = a₁) →
                    viable
                        (CGB.SelfProduction.openActionStep G W (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀))
                          a₀) ∧
                      viable
                          (CGB.SelfProduction.openActionStep G W (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁))
                            a₁) ∧
                        ¬(viable
                                (CGB.SelfProduction.openActionStep G W
                                  (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀))
                                  (G.policy (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)).1)) ∧
                              viable
                                (CGB.SelfProduction.openActionStep G W
                                  (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁))
                                  (G.policy (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁)).1))) ∧
                          -(Real.log (1 - predict (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₀)).1) +
                                  Real.log (predict (CGB.SelfProduction.maskedOpenRun G W quiet n (s, w₁)).1)) /
                              2 ≥
                            Real.log 2
doc: On the same masked open-world runs, combine the prediction loss with a world-dependent viability requirement. This does not assert that real language worlds meet the two opposite-target or safe-action conditions.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.merged_histories_binary_logloss_floor
signature:
∀ {History : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} (encode : History → State) (predict : State → ℝ) (h₀ h₁ : History),
  encode h₀ = encode h₁ →
    0 < predict (encode h₀) →
      predict (encode h₀) < 1 → -(Real.log (1 - predict (encode h₀)) + Real.log (predict (encode h₁))) / 2 ≥ Real.log 2
doc: If two equally likely histories share the same accessible state but require opposite next-byte predictions, any positive binary predictor pays at least `log 2` nats of expected loss. A predictor with the distinguishing information can assign probability one to the correct byte and has zero loss. The equal probabilities are a world condition, not a universal drift law.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.mixed_key_delta_differs_from_slot_assimilation
doc: A normalized mixed key gives a concrete obstruction to general equality: the delta write couples the first slot to the second, while independent precision assimilation with zero target leaves its zero mean unchanged.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.one_hot_delta_is_precision_assimilation
signature:
∀ {n : ℕ} (slot : Fin n) (row : Fin n → ℝ) (p w value : ℝ),
  0 < p →
    0 ≤ w →
      CGB.Generation.tiedWrite (fun j => if j = slot then 1 else 0) (w / (p + w)) value row = fun j =>
        if j = slot then (p * row j + w * value) / (p + w) else row j
doc: For an exactly one-hot key, no global decay, and precision-derived gain, the delta write agrees with slotwise precision assimilation: only the keyed slot changes. This does not assert equality for mixed keys or nonzero decay.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.open_world_body_prediction_iff
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5} {World : Type u_6}
  (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageGenerator Hist State Byte Act Answer)
  (W : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableOpenWorld G World),
  (∃ predict,
      ∀ (s : State) (a : Act) (w : World),
        predict s a = CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext G s (W.boundary w s a)) ↔
    ∀ (s : State) (a : Act) (w₁ w₂ : World),
      CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext G s (W.boundary w₁ s a) =
        CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext G s (W.boundary w₂ s a)
doc: Exact body-only prediction of the next body state for every world state is possible precisely when hidden world variation has no effect on that next state. This is an expressibility result, not a learned self-model.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.open_world_categorical_next_loss_direction
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5} {World : Type u_6}
  [inst : DecidableEq Byte] (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageGenerator Hist State Byte Act Answer)
  (W : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableOpenWorld G World) (allocation : State → Byte → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (p w : ℝ),
  0 < p →
    0 < w →
      (∀ (b : Byte),
          0 < allocation (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1 b ∧
            allocation (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1 b < 1) →
        (∀ (b : Byte),
            allocation (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1 b =
              allocation (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1 b +
                w / (p + w) *
                  ((if
                        b =
                          W.boundary (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).2
                            (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1
                            (G.policy
                              (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1) then
                      1
                    else 0) -
                    allocation (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1 b)) →
          have C := CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W;
          have s := (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory C n).1;
          have s' := (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory C (n + 1)).1;
          have observed := W.boundary (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory C n).2 s (G.policy s);
          have next := W.boundary (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory C (n + 1)).2 s' (G.policy s');
          C.viable (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory C (n + 1)) ∧
            (-Real.log (allocation s' next) < -Real.log (allocation s next) ↔ next = observed) ∧
              (-Real.log (allocation s next) < -Real.log (allocation s' next) ↔ next ≠ observed)
doc: The categorical innovation condition applied to the actual boundary and the next actual boundary on one viable open-world trajectory. The next symbol is used only to assess the result; it is not an input to the earlier update.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.open_world_closure_excludes_conflicting_safe_actions
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5} {World : Type u_6}
  (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageGenerator Hist State Byte Act Answer)
  (W : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableOpenWorld G World) (h : Hist) (w₀ w₁ : World) (a₀ a₁ : Act),
  G.viable (G.encode h) →
    a₀ ≠ a₁ →
      (∀ (a : Act), G.viable (G.encode (G.advanceHistory h (W.boundary w₀ (G.encode h) a))) → a = a₀) →
        (∀ (a : Act), G.viable (G.encode (G.advanceHistory h (W.boundary w₁ (G.encode h) a))) → a = a₁) → False
doc: The present `RenewableOpenWorld.closed` quantifies over every hidden world state at a viable encoded body. It therefore excludes a pair of worlds that require two different actions for even one-step body viability. This pinpoints a limitation of that contract, not an impossibility of life in such worlds.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.open_world_input_not_body_determined
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5} {World : Type u_6}

  W.boundary w₁ s a ≠ W.boundary w₂ s a →
    ∀ (predict : State → Act → Byte), ¬(predict s a = W.boundary w₁ s a ∧ predict s a = W.boundary w₂ s a)
doc: If hidden world states can give different boundary inputs at the same organism state and action, no state-only predictor is correct for both.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.open_world_precision_update_improves_next_prediction
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Act : Type u_3} {Answer : Type u_4} {World : Type u_5}
  (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageGenerator Hist State Bool Act Answer)
  (W : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableOpenWorld G World) (prob : State → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (p w : ℝ),
  0 < p →
    0 < w →
      0 < prob (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1 →
        prob (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1 < 1 →
          prob (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1 =
              prob (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1 +
                w / (p + w) *
                  ((if
                        W.boundary (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).2
                            (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1
                            (G.policy
                              (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1) =
                          true then
                      1
                    else 0) -
                    prob (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1) →
            W.boundary (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).2
                  (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1
                  (G.policy (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1) =
                W.boundary (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).2
                  (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1
                  (G.policy (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1) →
              (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W).viable
                  (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)) ∧
                (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1 ≠
                    (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1 ∧
                  CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy
                      (CGB.Generation.binaryPointLaw
                        (W.boundary
                          (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).2
                          (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1
                          (G.policy
                            (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1)))
                      (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation
                        (prob
                          (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1)) <
                    CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy
                      (CGB.Generation.binaryPointLaw
                        (W.boundary
                          (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).2
                          (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1
                          (G.policy
                            (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) (n + 1)).1)))
                      (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation
                        (prob (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1))
doc: An actual open-world update improves the next prediction when the next delivered bit repeats the current one and the same body's probability obeys the existing precision-derived innovation update. Both scores target the actual next bit; the condition is not a claim that arbitrary streams repeat.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.passive_opportunity_bounds_eventual_interventions
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} (c : CGB.SelfProduction.Contract S A I) (passive : A)
  (opportunity : S → ℕ) (intake : S → I → ℕ),
  (∀ (s : S), opportunity (c.step s (c.response s passive)) + intake s (c.response s passive) ≤ opportunity s) →
    ∀ (actions : ℕ → A),
      CGB.ActiveInference.eventuallyPassive actions passive →
        ∃ B,
          ∀ (T : ℕ),
            CGB.ActiveInference.cumulative
                (fun n =>
                  have s := CGB.SelfProduction.controlledTrajectory c actions n;
                  intake s (c.response s (actions n)))
                T ≤
              B
doc: A finite passive opportunity potential supplies the universal counterfactual bound required by `counterfactual_passive_bound_forces_activity`.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.passive_opportunity_budget
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} (c : CGB.SelfProduction.Contract S A I) (actions : ℕ → A) (passive : A)
  (opportunity : S → ℕ) (intake : S → I → ℕ),
  (∀ (s : S), opportunity (c.step s (c.response s passive)) + intake s (c.response s passive) ≤ opportunity s) →
    ∀ (start : ℕ),
      (∀ (n : ℕ), start ≤ n → actions n = passive) →
        ∀ (T : ℕ),
          (opportunity (CGB.SelfProduction.controlledTrajectory c actions (start + T)) +
              ∑ n ∈ Finset.range T,
                have s := CGB.SelfProduction.controlledTrajectory c actions (start + n);
                intake s (c.response s (actions (start + n)))) ≤
            opportunity (CGB.SelfProduction.controlledTrajectory c actions start)
doc: If each passive use spends from a finite opportunity potential, the total passive intake from that point cannot exceed the starting potential. The potential is a function of the existing state, not an extra state.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.passive_opportunity_forces_activity
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} (c : CGB.SelfProduction.Contract S A I) (passive : A)
  (opportunity : S → ℕ) (intake : S → I → ℕ),
  (∀ (s : S), opportunity (c.step s (c.response s passive)) + intake s (c.response s passive) ≤ opportunity s) →
    (CGB.ActiveInference.unbounded fun n =>
        have s := CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory c n;
        intake s (c.response s (c.action s))) →
      ¬CGB.ActiveInference.eventuallyPassive (fun n => c.action (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory c n)) passive
doc: Finite passive opportunity and unbounded actual intake force recurrent non-passive action in the same deterministic world.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.positive_soft_query_changes_under_delta
signature:
∀ {dk : ℕ} [NeZero dk] (key query row : Fin dk → ℝ) (β value : ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin dk), 0 < key i) →
    (∀ (i : Fin dk), 0 < query i) →
      β ≠ 0 →
        value ≠ CGB.Generation.dot key row →
          0 < CGB.Generation.dot query key ∧
            CGB.Generation.dot query (CGB.Generation.tiedWrite key β value row) ≠ CGB.Generation.dot query row
doc: Strictly positive soft addresses necessarily overlap. Consequently a nonzero delta write changes every strictly positive raw query in any output coordinate with nonzero innovation. This is exact-real arithmetic; floating point softmax can underflow and dual or signed queries are not covered.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.precision_binary_sample_gain_not_future_guarantee
signature:
∀ (r : ℝ) (y : Bool) (p w : ℝ),
  0 < r →
    r < 1 →
      0 < p →
        0 < w →
          have β := w / (p + w);
          have r' := r + β * ((if y = true then 1 else 0) - r);
          CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy (CGB.Generation.binaryPointLaw y) (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation r') <
              CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy (CGB.Generation.binaryPointLaw y) (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation r) ∧
            CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation r) (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation r) ≤
              CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation r)
                (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation r')
doc: Fitting an arrived bit does not by itself improve the underlying stream: if the old binary predictor already equals the stream law, its expected log loss cannot improve after the precision-derived update. The same update still improves loss on the arrived bit. This compares both predictors on one law.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.precision_binary_update_is_predictive_improvement
signature:
∀ (r : ℝ) (y : Bool) (p w : ℝ),
  0 < r →
    r < 1 →
      0 < p →
        0 < w →
          have β := w / (p + w);
          have r' := r + β * ((if y = true then 1 else 0) - r);
          (0 ≤ r' ∧ r' ≤ 1 ∧ r' ≠ r) ∧
            CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy (CGB.Generation.binaryPointLaw y) (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation r') <
              CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy (CGB.Generation.binaryPointLaw y) (CGB.Generation.binaryAllocation r)
doc: The precision-derived gain used by the active GDN path is a valid binary predictive update whenever incoming precision is positive. This is the smallest analytic bridge from natural-parameter assimilation to the renewable life gate: no fixed learning-rate parameter is introduced.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.precision_distinguishes_equal_mean_histories
signature:
∀ (p₁ p₂ w mean observed : ℝ),
  0 < p₁ →
    0 < p₂ →
      0 < w →
        p₁ ≠ p₂ →
          observed ≠ mean →
            have next₁ := (p₁ * mean + w * observed) / (p₁ + w);
            have next₂ := (p₂ * mean + w * observed) / (p₂ + w);
            next₁ ≠ next₂ ∧ ¬∃ transition, transition mean observed = next₁ ∧ transition mean observed = next₂
doc: Two slots with the same current mean but different positive precisions produce different next means on the same nonmatching observation. Hence a deterministic transition reading only that mean cannot reproduce both.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.probeLoss_eq_candidate_erase
signature:
∀ {H : Type u_1} {P : Type u_2} {S : Type u_3} [Fintype H] [inst : DecidableEq H] [inst_1 : DecidableEq P]
  (probe : H → P) (recoverable : S → P → Bool) (before after : S) (old new : Finset H),
  Function.Injective probe →
    (∀ h ∈ old, recoverable before (probe h) = true) →
      (∀ h ∈ old, h ∉ new → recoverable after (probe h) = false) →
        CGB.SelfProduction.probeLoss probe recoverable before after old new = old.card - (old ∩ new).card
doc: Under explicit injective-probe and recoverability conditions, probe loss is exactly the candidate distinction erased by the update.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.quiet_identity_memory_marginal
signature:
∀ {U : Type u_1} {Λ : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {I : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U]
  [inst_2 : Fintype Λ] [inst_3 : DecidableEq Λ] [inst_4 : Fintype A] (M : CGB.Medium U Λ A I) (W : CGB.World U Λ I),
  (∀ (x y : U → Λ), M.kernel W.clock W.quiet x y = if x = y then 1 else 0) →
    ∀ (n₀ : ℕ) (x x₀ : U → Λ) (w₀ : W.W) (m : ℕ), ∑ w, M.memLaw W n₀ (m + 1) x w x₀ w₀ = ∑ w, M.memLaw W n₀ 1 x w x₀ w₀
doc: When quiet freezes the body, the historical tagged memory law has the same body marginal after the first observation at every later time. The world may still evolve; this uses only normalization of its transition kernel.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.quiet_identity_old_memory_iff_one_write
signature:
∀ {U : Type u_1} {Λ : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {I : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype U] [inst_1 : DecidableEq U]
  [inst_2 : Fintype Λ] [inst_3 : DecidableEq Λ] [inst_4 : Fintype A] (M : CGB.Medium U Λ A I) (W : CGB.World U Λ I),
  (∀ (x y : U → Λ), M.kernel W.clock W.quiet x y = if x = y then 1 else 0) →
    (M.Remembers W ↔ ∃ n₀, 0 < CGB.Medium.condMutualInfo fun x₀ w₀ x => ∑ w, M.memLaw W n₀ 1 x w x₀ w₀)
doc: For a body frozen under quiet, the old indefinitely retained conditional information requirement reduces exactly to a single positive-information write. This is a property of that historical criterion, not a claim that freezing is sufficient for a useful or adaptive memory.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.ranked_exists_recurrently_marked_path
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : Fintype E] (K : ℕ → CGB.EventChannels.Kernel S E)
  (mark : ℕ → S → E → S → Bool) (horizon : ℕ) (C : CGB.RecoveryCriteria.Ranked K mark horizon) (seed : S),
  C.region seed →
    ∃ path event,
      path 0 = seed ∧
        (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < (K t).step (path t) (event t) (path (t + 1))) ∧
          ∀ (start : ℕ), ∃ t, start ≤ t ∧ t < start + horizon ∧ mark t (path t) (event t) (path (t + 1)) = true
doc: A normalized finite event kernel has an infinite supported path from any initial state; a ranked certificate makes its marked events recurrent. This constructs a path, not a probability measure assigning it positive mass.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.ranked_supported_path_recurrent
signature:
∀ {S : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype S] [inst_1 : Fintype E] (K : ℕ → CGB.EventChannels.Kernel S E)
  (mark : ℕ → S → E → S → Bool) (horizon : ℕ) (C : CGB.RecoveryCriteria.Ranked K mark horizon) (path : ℕ → S)
  (event : ℕ → E),
  C.region (path 0) →
    (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < (K t).step (path t) (event t) (path (t + 1))) →
      ∀ (start : ℕ), ∃ t, start ≤ t ∧ t < start + horizon ∧ mark t (path t) (event t) (path (t + 1)) = true
doc: The existing ranked recovery certificate forces a marked event in every `horizon`-tick window along every infinite sequence of supported transitions. The sequence is a mathematical path, not an asserted infinite-path measure; the mark can denote any actually declared event.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.reachable_consequence_readout_iff
doc: Restrict exact consequence prediction to joint states reachable from the initial condition under action interventions. A body-state readout exists iff histories merged into the same body state have identical next-body consequences for every proposed action. This is representability, not identification from observations or proof that the predictor is learned.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_action_autonomous_eq
signature: CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionAutonomous = CGB.RenewableLearning.process true true false
doc: Closing the explicit action port with the existing policy recovers the whole original machine, not just a one-step marginal or a sample trace.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_action_machine_reproduces
signature:
∀ (t : ℕ) (z z' : CGB.RenewableLearning.S) (e : Option Unit),
  CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionMachine.step (CGB.RenewableLearning.policy (z.1 ())) z e z' =
    (CGB.RenewableLearning.process true true false).step t z e z'
doc: Supplying the old policy reproduces every joint event and successor-state probability of the original uncut process, including the vacuum case.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_action_world_contract
signature:
(∀ (a : CGB.RenewableLearning.Action),
    CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionRepresentative a ≠ CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum ∧
      CGB.RenewableLearning.policy (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionRepresentative a) = a) ∧
  (∀ (w : CGB.RenewableLearning.Env) (a : CGB.RenewableLearning.Action),
      (∀ (v : CGB.RenewableLearning.Env), 0 ≤ CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionWorld w a v) ∧
        ∑ v, CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionWorld w a v = 1) ∧
    (∀ (w v : CGB.RenewableLearning.Env) (q : CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell),
        q ≠ CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum →
          CGB.RenewableLearning.moves w (fun x => q) v =
            CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionWorld w (CGB.RenewableLearning.policy q) v) ∧
      CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionWorld CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedA 0 CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.missA = 0 ∧
        CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionWorld CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedA 1 CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.missA = 1
doc: This action kernel is normalized and agrees with the existing world for every live body. Explicit actions induce different next-world laws at a fixed world state. A do-action interpretation assumes this world mechanism remains invariant under intervention; multi-step survival is a separate obligation.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_action_zero_eventual_vacuum
signature:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    CGB.Energetics.law (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionAlways 0) CGB.RenewableLearning.initial n
        (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.trap) =
      1
doc: In the specified intervention model, constant action zero reaches vacuum with probability one after two ticks and remains there. This is a distinct intervention from the registered marginal-ghost cut, not a general survival or language-world theorem.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_action_zero_failure_steps
signature:
CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionMachine.step 0 CGB.RenewableLearning.initial (some ())
      (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.trap) =
    1 ∧
  CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionMachine.step 0
      (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.trap) (some ())
      (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.trap) =
    1
doc: Under the declared action-port intervention, holding action 0 sends the existing initial state to the trap and then to vacuum in two certain steps.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_hidden_branch_reopens_and_rewrites
signature:
∀ (t : ℕ),
  have P := CGB.RenewableLearning.process true true false;
  have s0 := (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedA);
  have s1 := (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedB);
  have s2 := (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.missB);
  have s3 := (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.probeB);
  have s4 := (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.answerB);
  have s5 := (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bSpent, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedB);
  have s6 := (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bReady, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedB);
  P.step t s0 (some ()) s1 = 1 / 2 ∧
    P.step (t + 1) s1 (some ()) s2 = 1 ∧
      P.step (t + 2) s2 (some ()) s3 = 1 ∧
        P.step (t + 3) s3 (some ()) s4 = 1 ∧
          P.step (t + 4) s4 (some ()) s5 = 1 ∧
            P.step (t + 5) s5 (some ()) s6 = 1 / 2 ∧
              CGB.RenewableLearning.writeCost true CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.miss CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady =
                  1 ∧
                CGB.RenewableLearning.writeCost true CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.answerB
                      CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search =
                    1 ∧
                  CGB.RenewableLearning.topup true CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.feed CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bSpent =
                      2 ∧
                    CGB.RenewableLearning.policy CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bReady = 1 ∧
                      CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionMachine.step 1 s6 (some ())
                            (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bReady, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedA) =
                          1 / 2 ∧
                        CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionMachine.step 1 s6 (some ())
                              (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bReady, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedB) =
                            1 / 2 ∧
                          CGB.SelfProduction.renewableActionMachine.step 0 s6 (some ())
                              (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bReady, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.missB) =
                            1
doc: A positive-probability hidden world change in the certified process can flow through mismatch, reopening, probing and a new write on the same body. At the resulting state the learned action and an action override induce distinct next-world outcomes. This is a supported branch, not a language capability.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_language_carrier_correct
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5}
  (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageGenerator Hist State Byte Act Answer),
  (∀ (h : Hist), CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageRead G (G.encode h) = G.required h) ∧
    ∀ (h : Hist) (b : Byte), CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext G (G.encode h) b = G.encode (G.advanceHistory h b)

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_language_carrier_trajectory
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5}
  (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageGenerator Hist State Byte Act Answer),
  (∀ (h : Hist), CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageRead G (G.encode h) = G.required h) ∧
    (∀ (h : Hist) (b : Byte),
        CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext G (G.encode h) b = G.encode (G.advanceHistory h b)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G).viable
          (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G) n)
doc: The same state carrier has its required readout, byte transition, and an unbounded viable trajectory. Continued adaptation, useful prediction and active action remain separate world/transition conditions.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_language_life_gate
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5} [inst : Fintype Byte]
  [inst_1 : Nonempty Byte] (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageLifeGenerator Hist State Byte Act Answer) (m : ℝ),
  (∀ (s : State),
      CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy (G.stream s) (G.allocation s) < Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Byte) - m) →
    (∀ (h : Hist), CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageRead G.carrier (G.carrier.encode h) = G.carrier.required h) ∧
      (∀ (h : Hist) (b : Byte),
          CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageNext G.carrier (G.carrier.encode h) b =
            G.carrier.encode (G.carrier.advanceHistory h b)) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ),
            (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G.carrier).viable
              (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G.carrier) n)) ∧
          ¬CGB.ActiveInference.eventuallyPassive
                (fun n =>
                  G.carrier.policy
                    (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G.carrier) n))
                G.passive ∧
            (¬∀ (a : Act) (b : Byte), G.predict b = G.response a b) ∧
              (∀ (s : State), 0 < CGB.PredictiveHarvest.growth (G.stream s) (G.allocation s) - m) ∧
                (∀ (N : ℕ),
                    ∃ n,
                      N ≤ n ∧
                        CGB.SelfProduction.renewablePredictiveUpdateEvent G.carrier G.stream G.allocation
                          (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G.carrier) n)
                          (G.carrier.world_response
                            (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G.carrier) n)
                            (G.carrier.policy
                              (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G.carrier)
                                n)))) ∧
                  ¬∃ N,
                      ∀ (n : ℕ),
                        N ≤ n →
                          CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G.carrier)
                              (n + 1) =
                            CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableLanguageContract G.carrier) n
doc: The renewable carrier, plus explicit predictive payment and recurrent learning conditions, yields one general-state language life gate. Recurrent learning is stated as a change of the same state under the same world response, so the result rules out eventual freezing without adding a clock or a second reserve.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_maintenance_and_supported_relearning
signature:
CGB.Exchange.Persists CGB.RenewableLearningClosure.body CGB.RenewableLearning.world CGB.RenewableLearningClosure.ec
    CGB.RenewableLearningClosure.material 0 ∧
  CGB.Exchange.SelfMaintains CGB.RenewableLearningClosure.body CGB.RenewableLearning.world
      CGB.RenewableLearningClosure.ec CGB.RenewableLearningClosure.material ∧
    (∀ (B : ℕ),
        ∃ T,
          0 <
              CGB.RenewableLearningControls.weight (CGB.RenewableLearning.process true true false)
                CGB.RenewableLearningControls.path T ∧
            B <
              ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T,
                CGB.RenewableLearning.writeCost true
                  (CGB.RenewableLearning.sense (CGB.RenewableLearningControls.path t).2 ())
                  ((CGB.RenewableLearningControls.path t).1 ())) ∧
      CGB.Exchange.survival (CGB.RenewableLearning.plant true true) CGB.RenewableLearning.world ⋯
            (CGB.RenewableLearning.ledger true true) false (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.world.sense) 6 =
          1 ∧
        CGB.Exchange.survival (CGB.RenewableLearning.plant false true) CGB.RenewableLearning.world ⋯
            (CGB.RenewableLearning.ledger false true) false (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.world.sense) 6 ≤
          1 / 2
doc: One stochastic body-world process has operational maintenance and arbitrarily many paid writes on supported finite prefixes; blocking reopening in the same world and initial conditions lowers the registered survival score by at least one half at tick six. The intervention also changes the declared outgoing accounting, and the prefix claim is not almost-sure infinite writing.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_maintenance_world_action_contrast
signature:
CGB.Exchange.SelfMaintains CGB.RenewableLearningClosure.body CGB.RenewableLearning.world CGB.RenewableLearningClosure.ec
    CGB.RenewableLearningClosure.material ∧
  (∀ (w v : CGB.RenewableLearning.Env) (q q' : CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell),
      q ≠ CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum →
        q' ≠ CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.vacuum →
          CGB.RenewableLearning.policy q = CGB.RenewableLearning.policy q' →
            CGB.RenewableLearning.moves w (fun x => q) v = CGB.RenewableLearning.moves w (fun x => q') v) ∧
    CGB.RenewableLearning.policy CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady = 0 ∧
      CGB.RenewableLearning.policy CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bReady = 1 ∧
        CGB.RenewableLearning.moves CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedA (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady)
              CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.missA =
            0 ∧
          CGB.RenewableLearning.moves CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedA (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bReady)
              CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.missA =
            1
doc: The already-certified stochastic process also has a concrete world-side action contrast. On live bodies its world law depends on the body only through the selected action. Two body states select different actions and give different next-world probabilities. This is not a fixed-body action intervention or a proof about a language world.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_observable_block_contract
signature:
(∀ (bit next : Bool) (i : Fin 11) (t : ℕ),
    0 <
      (CGB.RenewableLearning.process true true false).step t (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableBlock bit i)
        (some ())
        (if h : ↑i + 1 < 11 then CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableBlock bit ⟨↑i + 1, h⟩
        else CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableBlock next ⟨0, ⋯⟩)) ∧
  ∀ (bit : Bool),
    CGB.RenewableLearning.sense (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableBlock bit ⟨2, ⋯⟩).2 () =
      if bit = true then CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.miss else CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.feed
doc: Every step of either block, including the transition to either next block, has positive probability in the unchanged autonomous process. The world sensor at offset two distinguishes the two blocks. These are finite-path support facts, not an almost-sure statement or a language-performance experiment.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_observable_from_birth
signature:
∀ (bits : ℕ → Bool),
  CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableFromBirth bits 0 = CGB.RenewableLearning.initial ∧
    (∀ (N : ℕ),
        0 <
          CGB.RenewableLearningControls.weight (CGB.RenewableLearning.process true true false)
            (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableFromBirth bits) N) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ),
          CGB.RenewableLearning.sense (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableFromBirth bits (3 + 11 * k + 2)).2 () =
            if bits k = true then CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.miss else CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.feed) ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          bits k = true →
            CGB.RenewableLearning.writeCost true
                  (CGB.RenewableLearning.sense (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableFromBirth bits (3 + 11 * k + 2)).2
                    ())
                  ((CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableFromBirth bits (3 + 11 * k + 2)).1 ()) =
                1 ∧
              CGB.RenewableLearning.writeCost true
                  (CGB.RenewableLearning.sense (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableFromBirth bits (3 + 11 * k + 4)).2
                    ())
                  ((CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservableFromBirth bits (3 + 11 * k + 4)).1 ()) =
                1
doc: From the same original initial state, every finite prefix of every chosen bit sequence has positive support; sensory symbols distinguish the blocks, and each true block includes two actual paid writes. Individual infinite paths may have probability zero; no entropy-rate or full life claim is made.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_observable_path_contract
signature:
∀ (bits : ℕ → Bool),
  CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservablePath bits 0 =
      (fun x => CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady, CGB.RenewableLearning.Env.feedA) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ),
        0 <
          (CGB.RenewableLearning.process true true false).step n (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservablePath bits n)
            (some ()) (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservablePath bits (n + 1))) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ),
        CGB.RenewableLearning.sense (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableObservablePath bits (11 * k + 2)).2 () =
          if bits k = true then CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.miss else CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.feed
doc: Every finite prefix of every selected branch sequence has positive probability from the aligned state, and the existing sensor at offset two of each block recovers its selected bit. This supplies arbitrarily many distinct observable finite prefixes without assuming an infinite-path measure.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_always_passive_stays_search
signature:
∀ (bits : ℕ → Bool) (n : ℕ),
  CGB.SelfProduction.controlledTrajectory
      (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
        (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits))
      (fun x => 0) n =
    (CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search, n)
doc: In the open-stream witness an always-passive intervention stays in the non-vacuum `search` state forever. The witness therefore does not establish that activity is necessary for its non-vacuum viability predicate.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_distinct_inputs_reach_distinct_states
signature:
∀ (bits₁ bits₂ : ℕ → Bool),
  bits₁ 0 ≠ bits₂ 0 →
    (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
            (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
              (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits₁))
            0).1 =
        (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
            (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
              (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits₂))
            0).1 ∧
      (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
            (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
              (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits₁))
            1).1 ≠
        (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
            (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
              (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits₂))
            1).1
doc: Two worlds differing at the first observed bit start with the same body but lead to distinguishable body states after one boundary input.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_first_action_affects_body
signature:
∀ (bits : ℕ → Bool),
  (CGB.SelfProduction.controlledTrajectory
          (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
            (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits))
          (fun x => 0) 1).1 =
      CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search ∧
    (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
          (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
            (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits))
          1).1 ≠
      CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.search
doc: In this witness world, replacing the initial probe by the passive action changes the next body state: the passive step retains `search`, while the actual probe records the external answer.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_first_input_recorded
signature:
∀ (bits : ℕ → Bool),
  (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory
        (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableCarrier
          (CGB.SelfProduction.existingRenewableOpenWorld bits))
        1).1 =
    if bits 0 = true then CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aSpent else CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bSpent
doc: On the initial probe, the existing finite carrier records which external answer arrived. The value is supplied by the world, not the body state.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_language_joint_gate
signature:
∀ {Hist : Type u_1} {State : Type u_2} {Byte : Type u_3} {Act : Type u_4} {Answer : Type u_5} {World : Type u_6}
  [inst : Fintype Byte] [inst_1 : Nonempty Byte]
  (G : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableLanguageGenerator Hist State Byte Act Answer)
  (W : CGB.SelfProduction.RenewableOpenWorld G World) (stream allocation : State → Byte → ℝ),
  (∀ (s : State) (b : Byte), 0 ≤ stream s b) →
    (∀ (s : State), ∑ b, stream s b = 1) →
      (∀ (s : State) (b : Byte), 0 < allocation s b) →
        (∀ (s : State), ∑ b, allocation s b = 1) →
          ∀ (m : ℝ),
            (∀ (n : ℕ),
                CGB.PredictiveHarvest.crossEntropy
                    (stream (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1)
                    (allocation (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1) <
                  Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Byte) - m) →
              ∀ (signal : ℕ → ℕ) (passive : Act),
                CGB.ActiveInference.unbounded signal →
                  CGB.ActiveInference.passiveBounded
                      (fun n =>

                                (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1

                                  (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).2
                                  (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W) n).1
                                  (G.policy
                                    (CGB.SelfProduction.trajectory (CGB.SelfProduction.renewableOpenContract G W)
                                        n).1))) →

doc: Conditional joint gate on the *open* body-world trajectory. The actual boundary selects each learning event; the world may have its own unbounded state. Signal, passive limitation, predictive payment and recurrent useful updates are assumptions on this trajectory, not consequences of a local score step. The world-closure condition is the existing strong `W.closed`.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_probe_enables_conditional_action

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_probe_records_then_reopens

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_rewriting_loses_old_distinction

No body-only readout can recover the earlier bit after that merge. A world observation or accessible external record can change the information available to a later rule and is not ruled out here.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_stream_recurrently_writes

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_world_is_exogenous

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_open_world_trajectory

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_reopen_control_branch
signature:
(∀ n ≤ 4, CGB.RenewableLearningControls.path n = CGB.RenewableLearningControls.failingPath true n) ∧
  CGB.RenewableLearning.next true true CGB.RenewableLearning.Signal.miss CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady =

On the same mismatch, the normal body reopens while the disabled body holds the old candidate; the following world move distinguishes the resulting actions. Both paths and the paired survival bound are existing certificates.

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_reopening_not_single_old_advance

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_witness_unbounded_supported_writes

name: CGB.SelfProduction.renewable_world_hidden_branch_and_delayed_consequence

(∀ (q : CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell),
    q = CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.aReady ∨ q = CGB.RenewableLearning.Cell.bReady →
